game.title: Washington Commanders at New York Giants

lede: Washington Commanders carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#14 in EPA per play), while New York Giants owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#18 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it New York Giants −3.0 with a fair total of 45.0 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is New York Giants run offence vs Washington Commanders run defence, which sits +0.131 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.

The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Washington Commanders and New York Giants have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
